request.objective: Start at https://www.flightaware.com/. Find discussions of the community and open the one with the most replies of all time on Flightaware.

response.result:
FlightAware's community lives in **FlightAware Discussions**, the forum at discussions.flightaware.com (linked from the main site).

To pin down "most replies of all time" I used the forum's own Top list with the period set to **All time** and the ordering set to **Replies**, descending:
https://discussions.flightaware.com/top?ascending=false&order=posts&period=all

The thread at the top of that all-time replies ranking is:

**The Banter Thread** — General category
https://discussions.flightaware.com/t/the-banter-thread/4412

- Replies/posts: **5,519** (shown as "5.5k" in the Top list; the thread's own timeline reads **1 / 5519**)
- Views: **2,352,306** (2.4M)
- Span: Dec 2007 – Jun 2018, marked "Top" in General

It is open in the browser. The runner-up, "HOWTO: Airspy mini and Airspy R2: Piaware / dump1090-fa configuration," has 4,579 posts (4.6k), so there is a clear margin between first and second.
